items.lede: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.
items.title: Google’s AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode

items.lede: With temporary threads, any searches you run in Google’s AI Mode won’t be associated with your account or saved to your chat history.
items.title: Your Google AI mode searches can stay private now with ‘temporary threads’ – here’s how
